job: Show a site's own photograph in a section, cropped to a set shape and treated by the look.
purpose: A figure holding one img (its own width and height, so its place is held before it loads) and an optional caption. data-ratio crops it to a shape with object-fit cover, data-position keeps a side, data-frame gives it the media frame's hairline and radius. Its treatment (natural, mono, duotone, wash) comes from the look's imagery dial unless data-treatment sets its own: a filter and two blend layers, no script.
useWhen: A picture beside the hero's headline, in a split, in the bento's large cell, as a post's cover or as a figure in an article.
Art that should sit with the look rather than as shot: the dial sets every picture on the site at once.

avoidWhen.when: A picture a visitor supplied, an upload or an address from your data.
A screenshot or a specimen of the product.

avoidWhen.instead: Put the picture in .fd-site-backdrop on a section with data-ground="image" (site).

avoidWhen.when: A report or a resource with no picture of its own.

states.name: loading
states.how: before the picture arrives its place holds the ratio (data-ratio, or its width and height) on the sunken ground

variants.useWhen: A post's cover or a split's media: 4:3.
Beside a headline that runs several lines: 4:5.
A narrow column next to long text: 2:3.
The subject sits at the start or the top of the picture.
The subject is in the middle (the default).
The subject sits at the end or the bottom.
The picture stands on its own and needs the media frame's edge.
This picture stays as shot whatever the look.
This picture in greyscale, eased toward the page.
This picture as a two-ink print: shadows in the ink, lights in a tint of the accent.
This picture under a thin veil of the accent.

parts.role: The figure: an img with alt, width and height, and an optional figcaption.
